titleFront: No Money, No Parts, No Deal!

flipToBack.prose: Flip if Watto is PRESENT AT Watto's Junkyard AND you OCCUPY Mos Espa.

children.req: canSpot: Watto present at Watto's Junkyard (presence, not control)

flipToFront.prose: Flips back if Watto NOT present at Watto's Junkyard OR you do NOT occupy Mos Espa (exact negation of the flip law).

children.req: canSpot: Watto present at Watto's Junkyard

requirementSemantics: flipToBack leaf 1: PRESENCE (presentAt) of a specific character at a specific site - not control, not occupy
flipToBack leaf 2: OCCUPY Mos Espa (any of your cards) - not control
flipToFront: OR of the two negations; both conditions must be maintained to stay on back
opponent counter (both sides): opponent may use 8 Force to place Watto (at Watto's Junkyard) in Used Pile, then YOU choose to retrieve 0-4 Force - permanently threatens the Watto presence leg
setupAndPullRoutes: On deploy: deploy Watto's Junkyard and Mos Espa from Reserve Deck [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180.java:62-74]
Watto's Junkyard supplies a native once-per-game Watto pull from Reserve Deck; Watto deploys -2 there [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_178.java]

The recurring back engine is the once-per-deploy-phase face-down-card gambit (opponent loses 2 and card to Used, or opponent uses 2 and you deploy it free; if free-deploy is impossible you lose 2 Force and the card) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180_BACK.java:129-195]
otherObligations: Remainder of game (front, after deployment): Watto's Junkyard immune to Revolution [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180.java:79-85]

Front modifiers: Qui-Gon power +3 (downside); opponent loses max 1 Force from your drains at Tatooine sites [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180.java:151-152]

Both sides: opponent action - use 8 Force, place Watto in Used Pile, you may retrieve up to 4 Force [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180.java:88-143, src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180_BACK.java:64-119]
Back modifier: opponent's non-unique aliens deploy +3 [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180_BACK.java:122-126]

Back gambit may be buffed by ModifyGameTextType.YOURE_A_SLAVE__DRAW_TOP_CARD_OF_RESERVE_DECK_WHEN_PLACING_A_CARD_IN_USED_PILE [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set12/dark/Card12_180_BACK.java:203-215]
